description: Consciousness plunges into the Middle Ages, the horns of Frankish knights charge, investigators embody Crusader knights experiencing another era on the battlefield.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The morning light slanted across Lightning's mane, gilding it with a golden edge. Jean-Louis flicked the whip with a flourish, wrapped the reins twice around his wrist, and grinned: "Let's go!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Let's go, let our devout follower pray properly, and then we" #make an on-the-hour gesture

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The carriage rumbled through the morning fog of Boulevard Saint-Michel. Jean-Louis hummed an off-key version of Ave Maria, while Lightning's horseshoes tapped a crisp rhythm on the damp cobblestones. Passing the National Library, he suddenly reined in, pretending to adjust the harness, but leaned back instead—"Professor," he whispered, a brass key slipping from his sleeve and falling silently into the folds of Professor Bailan's skirt. "Old Marcel had a gout attack this morning..." He winked. "The lock on the library's west side door 'recognizes people' until noon."

conversation.text: The brass key made a grating click in the lock. The moment player4 pushed open the iron-bound oak door, the smells of aged parchment, rust, and insect repellent washed over them.

conversation.speaker: player5

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "We'll be back soon"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Ha! Seems books are more charming than this old bone! He flicked his whip and gestured toward the library with his chin. Tell player4 the doctor that if old Marcel catches you, say it was Jean-Louis's idea! That old fellow owes me three bottles of apple wine!

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hiss, although I don't understand French, it seems to mean 'No Entry.' What do you think, Professor?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: In the dim space, several rows of tall cast-iron bookshelves stood in orderly lines. The gilt titles on the spines reflected the sunlight faintly. You see several heavy 16th-century tomes chained to reading stands, the edges of their pages showing clear signs of insect damage.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I suppose this place is probably like Miskatonic University's restricted section."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It's fine. We're here precisely for the restricted books."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Even the boss probably couldn't afford to pay for all the books here. I don't think you need to remind us, but still, handle with care."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mm-hmm, okay."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #pulling player4 along "We should head to the cathedral. It's not good to keep others waiting too long. See you at 7."
